```haskell
module Main (main) where

import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed.Mutable as V
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed as UV

main :: IO ()
main = do
  inp <- getContents
  let ns = words inp
  if null ns then return () else do
    let n = read (head ns) :: Int
    col  <- V.replicate n False
    d1   <- V.replicate (2 * n - 1) False
    d2   <- V.replicate (2 * n - 1) False
    ans  <- newIORef (0 :: Int)
    let solve r
          | r == n = modifyIORef' ans (+1)
          | otherwise = mapM_ (try r) [0 .. n - 1]
        try r c = do
          b1 <- V.read col c
          b2 <- V.read d1 (r + c)
          b3 <- V.read d2 (r - c + n - 1)
          if b1 || b2 || b3 then return () else do
            V.write col c True
            V.write d1 (r + c) True
            V.write d2 (r - c + n - 1) True
            solve (r + 1)
            V.write col c False
            V.write d1 (r + c) False
            V.write d2 (r - c + n - 1) False
    solve 0
    a <- readIORef ans
    putStrLn (show a)
